narrative: This is a preliminary report. The final report along with market commentary will be available tomorrow morning 8/18/26. Supply included: 96% Feeder Cattle (60% Steers, 40% Heifers); 4% Replacement Cattle (44% Bred Cows, 56% Bred Heifers). Feeder cattle over 600 lbs was 48%. Feeder Cattle prices FOB based on net weights after a 0-3% pencil shrink or equivalent, with a 14-28 cent slide > 600 lbs and 24-60 cent slide < 600 lbs.
